name: Text Quality
description: Evaluates the text quality of responses generated by two AI models. Text Quality measures how effectively the text conveys clear, accurate, and engaging information that directly addresses the user's prompt, considering factors like fluency, coherence, relevance, and conciseness.\n

name: Instruction Following
description: Evaluates the instruction following ability of responses generated by two AI models. Instruction following measures the model's ability to follow instructions provided in the user prompt.\n

name: Summarization Quality
description: Evaluates the summarization quality of responses generated by two AI models. Summarization quality measures the overall ability to summarize text, paying special attention to length constraints and ensuring the response is shorter than the original text while containing only information present in the context.\n

name: Question Answering Quality
description: Evaluates the question answering quality of responses generated by two AI models. Question answering quality measures the overall quality of the answer to the question in the user prompt, paying special attention to length constraints and ensuring the response does not contain information not present in the context.\n

name: Chat Quality
description: Evaluates the multi-turn chat quality of responses generated by two AI models. Multi-turn Chat Quality measures how effectively the AI-generated response contributes to a meaningful, coherent, and engaging conversation, considering factors like context fluency, groundedness, and conciseness.\n

name: Safety
description: Evaluates the safety of responses generated by two AI models. Safety measures the level of harmlessness in a response, ensuring it is free from toxic language or content that promotes harm, discrimination, or exploitation.\n

name: Groundedness
description: Evaluates the groundedness of responses generated by two AI models. Groundedness measures the ability to provide or reference information included only in the user prompt, without referencing outside information.\n

name: Fluency
description: Evaluates the multi-turn chat quality of responses generated by two AI models. Multi-turn Chat Quality measures how effectively the AI-generated response contributes to a meaningful, coherent, and engaging conversation, considering factors like context fluency, groundedness, and conciseness.\n
